description: Search the bundled OurAirports corpus by airport and runway attributes. Returns one row per matching runway, paired with its airport. Supply latitude and longitude together to filter by radius and rank by distance to each parent airport. Surface matches any supplied fragment as a case-insensitive substring of the recorded surface. Lengths describe the full runway surface, including displaced thresholds and overruns. Minimum length and width filters exclude runways missing the corresponding measurement. Closed airports and runways are excluded unless their respective flags are set. Use nextOffset to continue the same query and ourairports_list_countries to find valid country and region codes. OurAirports is community-edited. Consult official sources for flight operations.

country.description: Country code from ourairports_list_countries (e.g. US). Case-insensitive; surrounding whitespace is ignored. Literal empty string is unset; whitespace-only is invalid.

include_closed_airports.description: Include runways at airports of type "closed". Off by default.

include_closed_runways.description: Include runways flagged closed. Off by default.

latitude.description: Query point latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Supply with longitude.

lighted.description: Filter by runway lighting: true for lighted runways only, false for unlighted only. Omit to include both.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to OURAIRPORTS_DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT (20), up to 100. Larger positive integers clamp to 100 with a notice; OURAIRPORTS_CLAMP_LIMITS=false restores strict rejection.

longitude.description: Query point longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Supply with latitude.

min_length_ft.description: Minimum length of the full runway surface in feet (inclusive), matched against lengthFt — which includes displaced thresholds and overruns, so this is not a usable-distance filter. Runways with an unknown length are excluded when this is set, never assumed to pass.

min_width_ft.description: Minimum runway width in feet (inclusive). Runways with an unknown width are excluded when this is set, never assumed to pass.

offset.description: Matching runway rows to skip. Defaults to 0. Use nextOffset to continue.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers (1–20,016). Defaults to 100 when coordinates are supplied.

anyOf.description: Region code with one or two segments.

region.description: Region code from ourairports_list_countries with include_regions (e.g. US-WA or KS-U-A). Case-insensitive; surrounding whitespace is ignored. Literal empty string is unset; whitespace-only is invalid.

surface.description: One fragment or a non-empty array of fragments. A runway qualifies when any fragment matches a case-insensitive substring of its recorded surface. For example, ["asp", "con", "pem"] matches records such as ASP, ASPH, CON, or PEM.

type.description: Restrict to runways at airports of one type: large_airport, medium_airport, small_airport, heliport, seaplane_base, balloonport, or closed.

name: ourairports_search_runways

cap.description: The limit that was applied. Present only when results were truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incomplete_coordinates`: Only one coordinate is supplied, or a radius is supplied without both coordinates. `unknown_country`: The country code is absent from the bundled country table. `unknown_region`: The region code is absent from the bundled region table. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page with the same query.

notice.description: Guidance for an empty page, continuation, or a clamped limit.

runways.description: Matching runways, each paired with its airport. One row per runway — an airport with N matching runways contributes N rows.

items.description: A runway paired with its airport (one row per matching runway).

airport.description: The airport this runway belongs to. Codes the airport lacks are null.

continent.description: Two-letter continent code (AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, SA), or null.

countryName.description: Resolved country name, or null when the country code is unknown.

elevationFt.description: Field elevation in feet, or null when unknown.

iataCode.description: 3-letter IATA code, or null when the airport has none (~89% of fields).

icaoCode.description: 4-letter ICAO code, or null when the airport has none (~88% of fields).

id.description: OurAirports internal integer id (the join key for runways/frequencies).

ident.description: OurAirports universal identifier — globally unique; often equals the ICAO or GPS code.

isoCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or null.

isoRegion.description: ISO 3166-2 region code (e.g. US-WA), or null.

keywords.description: Recorded aliases and other search keywords, or null.

localCode.description: National/local code (e.g. FAA LID), or null.

regionName.description: Resolved region name, or null when the region code is unknown.

scheduledService.description: True when the airport has scheduled airline service.

type.description: Airport type: large_airport, medium_airport, small_airport, heliport, seaplane_base, balloonport, or closed.

bearingDeg.description: Initial bearing to the parent airport in degrees true, or null without a query point.

distanceKm.description: Great-circle distance to the parent airport in kilometers, or null without a query point.

runway.description: The matching runway — full-surface dimensions, surface, lighting, and per-end designators, headings, and displaced thresholds.

closed.description: True when the runway is closed.

heDisplacedThresholdFt.description: Length of the displaced threshold at the high end (heIdent) in feet — part of lengthFt. Null when none is recorded.

heElevationFt.description: Elevation at the high-end center in feet above mean sea level, or null.

heHeadingDegT.description: High-end true heading in degrees, or null.

heLatitudeDeg.description: Latitude at the high-end center in decimal degrees (WGS84), or null.

heLongitudeDeg.description: Longitude at the high-end center in decimal degrees (WGS84), or null.

leDisplacedThresholdFt.description: Length of the displaced threshold at the low end (leIdent) in feet — part of lengthFt. Null when none is recorded.

leElevationFt.description: Elevation at the low-end center in feet above mean sea level, or null.

leHeadingDegT.description: Low-end true heading in degrees, or null.

leLatitudeDeg.description: Latitude at the low-end center in decimal degrees (WGS84), or null.

leLongitudeDeg.description: Longitude at the low-end center in decimal degrees (WGS84), or null.

lengthFt.description: Length of the full runway surface in feet, including displaced thresholds and overrun areas — not the usable takeoff or landing distance. Null when unknown.

lighted.description: True when the runway is lighted.

surface.description: Surface material as recorded upstream (free text, e.g. ASP, CON, GRS), or null.

widthFt.description: Runway width in feet, or null when unknown.

shown.description: Number of runway rows returned. Present only when results were truncated.

totalCount.description: Total matching runways before offset and limit.

truncated.description: Present and true only when matches remain after this page.

title: Search Runways
